paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of GPT-o4-mini over five rounds of conversation when receiving either binary or detailed feedback from a solution validator, under the CUBE-easy task with Solution Validator. The x-axis, labeled "Round of Conversation," ranges from 1 to 5 with a linear scale and integer tick marks at each round. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 10% to 25% with a linear scale and tick marks at 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25%. Two lines are shown: the orange line with circular markers represents "Binary" feedback, and the blue line with circular markers represents "Detailed" feedback. Both lines start at 10% accuracy in Round 1 and increase monotonically across rounds. For the "Binary" feedback, accuracy rises from 10% in Round 1 to approximately 22% in Round 5. For the "Detailed" feedback, accuracy increases from 10% in Round 1 to approximately 27% in Round 5. The blue line remains consistently above the orange line throughout all rounds, indicating higher accuracy with detailed feedback.
